report.summary: Patient P-D005 (34F, commercial Employer HMO, home tract 17031241400) was seen today for food-resource needs. Her most recent social-needs screener (2026-10-22) did not flag food insecurity (food_worry and food_ran_out both "never_true"), so these are preventive/optional resources rather than urgent referrals. Four community food resources were identified; eligibility noted where available.

options.name: Northwest Side Food Pantry
options.how_to_access: Open Mon/Wed/Fri 12-3 PM; no ID required; fresh produce Wednesdays.

options.name: Madison Street Community Fridge
options.how_to_access: Open daily 8 AM-8 PM; take what you need; no eligibility restrictions listed.

options.name: Saturday Market Pantry
options.how_to_access: Saturdays 9 AM-noon; Cook County residents eligible (patient's tract is in Cook County).

options.name: Westside Grocery Rescue
options.how_to_access: Free and low-cost options for people with chronic illness; verify eligibility/contact before visiting.
